channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the House
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/18/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: HB 1216 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Schoolcraft
item.description: Relating to the amendment of restrictive covenants applicable to certain subdivisions.

item.title: HB 1217 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hernandez
item.description: Relating to a required notice of breast arterial calcification on certain mammography reports.

item.title: HB 1218 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Vasut
item.description: Relating to residence for purposes of voting and other matters affecting a candidate's eligibility.

item.title: HB 1219 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hernandez
item.description: Relating to unprofessional conduct by mental health providers who attempt to change the sexual orientation of a child.

item.title: HB 1220 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hernandez
item.description: Relating to prohibited nonconsensual medical procedures and treatment on foster children with intersex traits.

item.title: HB 1221 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hernandez
item.description: Relating to the eligibility for unemployment compensation of certain employees who leave the workplace to care for a minor child.

item.title: HB 1222 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Hernandez
item.description: Relating to eligibility for unemployment compensation for employees who leave the workplace due to sexual harassment.

item.title: HB 1223 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Howard
item.description: Relating to substance use disorder treatment services provided and organizations eligible for funding under the Thriving Texas Families Program.

item.title: HB 1224 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Collier
item.description: Relating to a defense to prosecution for the possession of certain consumable hemp products containing a controlled substance or marihuana.

item.title: HB 1225 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Herbert
item.description: Relating to the portion of the value of property that is a data center that may be exempted from ad valorem taxation under agreements entered into under the Property Redevelopment and Tax Abatement Act.

item.title: HB 1226 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Herbert
item.description: Relating to the requirement that a state agency publish a summary of the purpose of each form on the agency ’s Internet website.

item.title: HB 1227 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Herbert
item.description: Relating to an annual report by the Texas Education Agency regarding public school campus closures.

item.title: HB 1228 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Herbert
item.description: Relating to increasing the criminal penalty for the offense of making a firearm accessible to a child.
